messages:
Priya (SE): starting POC validation with FinLedger. They want to exercise CMK rotation behavior under load. Question: will daily rotations during the POC be supported and billable? @Tom can you confirm procurement ask?

Tom (AE): procurement asked about an explicit line item for rotation operations during the trial. They expect our platform to support scripted rotations without added per-rotation fees, but want transparency. Will check with finance.

Jordan (CryptoOps): technical note: rotations must ensure KV cache and prefix entries are handled. With HSM-backed CMKs we recommend a short quiesce and TTL flush; otherwise sessions may fail. Latency delta observed: ~20-50ms on switch.

Marcus (FinLedger): our goal is zero-downtime rotation proof. We'll run rotated requests during mock market hours. Prefer rotation window outside 13:00-18:00 UTC. Also must capture audit trail for each rotation.

Kelsey (PS): runbook proposal (high level):
1) create new key version in customer HSM
2) call Redwood key-proxy rotate API (dry-run first)
3) flush in-memory caches / short TTLs
4) cut traffic to new version, run acceptance checks
5) fallback to previous version if hashes mismatch

Kelsey (PS): example dry-run call we can demo:
```
POST /v1/key-proxy/rotate
{
  "customer_id": "finledger-01",
  "cmk_alias": "finledger-main",
  "dry_run": true
}
```
Dry-run will validate mapping and return a simulated diff. No key material leaves the HSM.

Jordan (CryptoOps): add: dry-run should include a simulated TTL flush and a check that KV-cache invalidation is possible without restarting workers. If the HSM import is manual, allow for an attestation step.

Nina (Legal): include audit clause in SOW: Redwood to provide rotation attestations with sigs + timestamps and an exportable audit log for the POC period. Also define responsibility for key custody during rotation.

Tom (AE): finance says: POC rotations are included up to N per day (to be defined). If they exceed that we'll charge ops time. I'll circulate a short billing appendix.

Marcus (FinLedger): ack. We'll keep to <=2 rotations/day during POC if possible. Can you run the demo dry-run by Friday?

Kelsey (PS): yes, demo scheduled Friday 16:00 UTC. link (internal): https://play.redwood.ai/poc/finledger-rotate. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: heads-up: rotation-demo cluster reserved Fri 15:30-17:00 UTC for FinLedger dry-run.

Priya (SE): thanks everyone. action items: 1) Kelsey -> dry-run demo Friday 2) Jordan -> draft SOW appendix (tech + attestation) 3) Tom -> billing appendix 4) Marcus -> confirm exact rotation windows. will follow up after demo.

Tom (AE): looping procurement on draft billing. closing thread unless more issues. :slightly_smiling_face:

Priya (SE): no further comments. closing.

-- end of thread --
